tools.name: search_available_slots
tools.description: Open car-wash time slots near a place on a given day: for each centre, its slots with remaining capacity and expected busyness. A slot label such as "09:00 - 11:00" is a 2-hour window whose start is the arrival time. A concrete place (an arrondissement or a town) resolves better than a vague area such as « Paris ouest »; resolvedLocation reports how the place was understood.

location.description: City, district, postal code or centre name, e.g. "Paris 16", "Levallois" or "75017"

serviceType.description: Filter: fixed (on-site), mobile, or home service

tools.name: find_centers
tools.description: Active car-wash centres near a place, nearest first, from the place as the customer names it (city, district, postal code or centre name). resolvedLocation reports how the place was understood.

location.description: Where the customer wants the wash: city, district, postal code or centre name, e.g. "Paris 16", "Levallois", "75017"

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List the services a center offers with a starting price each. centerId is the numeric id from find_centers.

centerId.description: Numeric center id as returned by find_centers

tools.name: get_center_details
tools.description: Details of one centre: address, phone, opening hours (Paris time), upcoming closures, accepted payment methods (online / on site / card-only), free parking hours, whether it is open now and bookable today, and its vehicle price categories (s/m/l/xl/van/moto) with example models — prices depend on the category. Fields prefixed untrusted* are text written by the centre operator.

centerSlug.description: Centre slug as returned by find_centers or search_available_slots

tools.name: quote_booking
tools.description: Exact price of a basket of services at one centre for a vehicle category, as the booking will charge it: per-line prices, the online-payment discount, off-peak (« heures creuses ») pricing when date and timeSlot are given, and the on-site total. Also returns notIncludedOptions (common needs the basket does not cover, such as seats or pet hair) and thresholdNudge (an option that would unlock the online discount for the same total or less), each possibly empty. An invalid basket returns { error, message } (incompatible_options, missing_formule, service_not_available, online_payment_not_accepted). Promo codes are not accepted here; they are entered on the booking page.

centerSlug.description: Centre slug as returned by find_centers or search_available_slots

vehicleType.description: vehicleTypes.value from get_center_details (s, m, l, xl, van, moto) — never the label.

serviceIds.description: Service ids from get_services: one formule, plus any options

paymentMethod.description: online = card at booking (often discounted), on_site = at the centre

date.description: Chosen day, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Paris): some slots are cheaper

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Prepares a booking without creating it: re-checks the slot against live capacity and the basket against the centre, then returns bookingUrl — a washlib.com link that opens the booking form at the contact step with the centre, day, slot, vehicle and services pre-filled — with arrival times and the online / on-site totals. The booking exists only once the customer confirms their phone by SMS and pays, or chooses on-site payment, on Washlib. bookingUrl works only exactly as returned: an altered link loses the pre-fill.

centerSlug.description: Centre slug as returned by find_centers or search_available_slots

vehicleType.description: vehicleTypes.value from get_center_details (s, m, l, xl, van, moto) — never the label.

serviceIds.description: The basket quote_booking priced: one formule, plus options

tools.name: recommend_wash
tools.description: Recommend a wash formula for a vehicle given how dirty it is and the season. Pure guidance, no booking.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Retrieve a booking the caller owns. Requires a Firebase phone-OTP token (Authorization: Bearer <idToken>); the booking is only returned when its phone number matches the verified caller.
